name: Filajoy3D (Guangzhou Bingrui Technology Co., Ltd.)
summary: Amazon-first silk-PLA brand whose USPTO FILAJOY3D mark (Class 17, filed June 2025, registered February 2026) is owned by Guangzhou Bingrui Technology Co., Ltd. in China. Sells silk PLA in 1 kg spools and 4 x 250 g multicolour bundles. Nothing shows Bingrui extrudes filament itself.

product_lines.name: Silk PLA
product_lines.notes: 1 kg spools and 250 g x 4 multicolour bundles; +/-0.02-0.03 mm claimed.

additional_notes: Amazon is the only store found. There is no web trace of Bingrui as an extruder; it looks like an Amazon-first brand company, but no positive evidence of contract sourcing exists, so no relationship is recorded. Search also surfaced Guangzhou Yousu3D by proximity only: no evidence of a link.

provenance.conflicts: Trademark record read on Justia 2026-11-06: FILAJOY3D (serial 99260014, filed 2025-06-30, Class 17) applicant Guangzhou Bingrui Technology Co., Ltd., Panyu District, Guangzhou. Manufacturing origin unknown.
